text:
No single treaty ended World War II, and my earlier statement was wrong: the Treaty of Versailles (1919) ended World War I.

WWII ended through surrender documents and later treaties. Germany signed its instrument of surrender on May 7-8, 1945, and Japan signed on September 2, 1945. The formal peace settlements came afterward: the 1947 Paris Peace Treaties with Italy, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Finland, and the 1951 Treaty of San Francisco with Japan (in force 1952). Germany's final settlement didn't come until the 1990 Two Plus Four Treaty.
